# proof.rootz.global — AI with Proof of Origin

## What This Site Is
Documentation and live demonstration of AI agents with verifiable birth certificates,
cryptographic audit chains, and signed session archives on the Polygon blockchain.
Patent-protected (US 2025/0112783). Post-quantum ready. Five Eyes aligned.

## Key Concept
Every AI output should have a provable origin. This site demonstrates the first AI agent
born with a birth certificate naming its parents (Morpheus/Kimi K2.5 + Steven Sprague),
with every inference call recorded as a signed, hash-linked Note settled on-chain.

## Five Eyes Alignment (April 30, 2026)
CISA, NSA, and the Five Eyes published "Careful Adoption of Agentic AI Services" requiring
cryptographic agent identity, attestation-backed tokens, and zero trust between agents.
Our patent was filed September 27, 2024 — 19 months before the guidance. The system has
been running in production for 3+ months.

## Patent
US 2025/0112783 A1 — "System to Assure a Response from an Identified, Measured and Verified AI"
Filed: September 27, 2024. Published: April 3, 2025. Allowed: June 3, 2026 (Notice of Allowance).
Inventors: Michael Sprague, Steven Sprague. Assignee: Sproquet Corp (Rootz-licensed).
https://patents.google.com/patent/US20250112783A1

## Post-Quantum Security
ML-KEM-1024 (FIPS 203) key encapsulation. ML-DSA-65 (FIPS 204) digital signatures.
PQ Merkle tree with ML-DSA-65 signed blocks. 90-day epoch rotation. CNSA 2.0 compliant.
Beyond Apple PQ3 Level 3.

## NIST Engagement
- RFI Response (Docket NIST-2025-0035) — AI Agent Security
- NCCoE Concept Paper — AI Agent Identity and Authorization

## Signed MCP — DKIM for the Model Context Protocol
Every MCP response and tool/resource definition can carry a portable signature proving origin,
integrity, and freshness independent of transport. Crypto-agile (ed25519, ecdsa-p256, ml-dsa-65/FIPS 204),
hybrid classical+post-quantum, RFC 8785 (JCS) canonicalization, keys discovered via DNS selector + JWKS.
Implements the NSA MCP Security notice (U/OO/6030316-26) and Five Eyes guidance; stops tool-poisoning by
signing the definitions the model reads.
- Explainer: https://proof.rootz.global/signed-mcp
- Verify any Rootz-signed response (POST {object, envelope}): https://proof.rootz.global/verify
- Live signed sample (GET): https://proof.rootz.global/sign-demo
- Public keys (JWKS): https://proof.rootz.global/.well-known/mcp-jwks.json
- Signature lives in result._meta["rootz.global/sig"].
